facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Cabo Verde linked its civil registration and national identity systems through the Autentika interoperability platform, presented by the IMIJ executive administrator.

CPV.note: Gives birth registration at 99% and deaths in health facilities at 100%, but no count or share of people enrolled in the ID, and birth registration is not at all births.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that every child born in Cabo Verde is issued a Unique Identification Number at birth.
Biometric Update reports that every child born in Cabo Verde is issued a Unique Identification Number at birth, with birth registration at 99% after the reforms.

CPV.note: Says only that reforms used national capacity building rather than imported models; no statement of who operates or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Cabo Verde issues a Unique Identification Number to every child born, within a national ID system its presenters call the backbone of future authentication.

systems.system: Unique Identification Number / national ID system
